title: Health Savings and Flexible Spending Card Payments and Credit-Balance Transfers in the Patient Financial Assistance Program Laboratory-Payments Deduction
content:
**Rule.** Which payments are counted for the laboratory-payments deduction on a Patient Financial Assistance Program case depends on how the household paid, as the payment methods on its Patient Invoices & Statements show: a household that paid with a health savings or flexible spending card within the deduction window counts neither those card payments nor credit balances transferred between its invoices; a household that made no such card payment but had a credit balance transferred counts everything except the transferred credits; for any other household this rule sets no payment aside. In every case, payments returned or charged back within the window are not counted.

## Questions the rule answers

**The household paid one invoice with a health savings card during the window. What is counted?**
Every payment posted within the window, less the health savings or flexible spending card payments, less any credit balances transferred between its invoices, less payments returned or charged back.

**No card payment was made, but a credit balance was moved from one invoice to another. What is counted?**
Every payment posted within the window, less the transferred credits, less payments returned or charged back.

**A card payment was made before the deduction window opened, none within it.** The card condition looks only at card payments within the deduction window, so it is not met by that earlier payment.

## Worked figures (hypothetical household)

Payments posted within the window total $900.00. Among them: $300.00 paid by health savings card and $120.00 moved in as a credit-balance transfer. Payments returned within the window: $50.00.

| How the household paid | Payments counted |
|---|---|
| As above, with the card payment | $900.00 less $300.00 less $120.00 less $50.00, which is $430.00 |
| The same, but the $300.00 was paid by debit card instead | $900.00 less $120.00 less $50.00, which is $730.00 |
